spans.s:
औ 1. औ, the fourteenth letter of the
alphabet, having the same sound as ओउ in our.
—औ-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound औ.

औ 2. औ, ind. an interjection of calling,
Ho, Hola; of addressing, Oh; of prohibition and
of asseveration.

औ 3. औ, औस्, m. sound; an epithet of
Śeṣa or Ananta; (औस्), f. the earth.
